decisions.reason: A polymer concrete drain housing extends the firm's core drainage-body engineering and manufacturing know-how, so it can interpret early market results and keep improving the product.
Floor-level shower drainage is the heart of the firm's knowledge base and strategic direction, giving it high absorptive capacity to refine the system.
A designer shower drain builds directly on the firm's design-plus-drainage competence and its compatible product families, and it has its own web page.
A shower element with integrated slope fits the firm's move toward integrated low-profile systems and its waterproofing know-how, though it is only mentioned and lies somewhat further from the core.
The backflow-protected basement drain was developed in-house and uses the firm's proven drainage technology, so the firm can assimilate the feedback and apply it.
The air-admittance valve is a complementary drainage accessory adjacent to existing know-how, but it is peripheral and only mentioned, so it carries a moderate risk of being dropped.
